notes: Thread worker sets up shared asset state and player hair-set memory while branching on the two crowd-asset loading messages; message strings are passed in this worker path.
Iterates free-agent card entries and passes the exact PrevFreeAgent and NextFreeAgent key addresses to the player-card hit-zone registration helper.
Checks team-player card context and registers the PrevTeamPlayer and NextTeamPlayer key pair through the hit-zone helper.
Sets up a rotation-player card hit zone and registers the PrevRotationPlayer and NextRotationPlayer key pair.
Reads ITEM_PICK and PICK_SLOT, validates the slot selection and passes item/slot values to the subsequent selection/update helpers.
Creates a player-card hit zone and passes the general PrevPlayer and NextPlayer key addresses to the registration helper.
The Head2Head context/status branches select the MatchFound or MatchFailed message address and send the resulting status through the context helper.
Creates the selected-player hit zone, bounds-checks the selected entry, then passes the PrevSelPlayer and NextSelPlayer keys to the hit-zone helper.

After checking card/selection state and resolving the matching entry, passes the exact right-player key pair (0x7001c6f033 and 0x7001cc0291) to process_player_card_hit_zone; addresses match the PrevRightPlayer/NextRightPlayer pair used by peer handlers.

Validates the selection index, resolves its roster entry, and dispatches through the hit-zone helper with the general PrevPlayer/NextPlayer event pair; same full-address pair is independently named in the navigation checker.
Reads the current card slot and indexed player record, then dispatches with the same general PrevPlayer/NextPlayer keys used by the other generic handlers.
Checks menu/controller state and resolves the left-side entry, then passes the exact PrevLeftPlayer/NextLeftPlayer key pair to the shared hit-zone helper; it does not use the right-player keys.
Reads the current player-card index and selected entry, then passes the general PrevPlayer/NextPlayer key pair to the shared helper.
Bounds-checks the requested player index, resolves the card entry and dispatches using the general PrevPlayer/NextPlayer pair.
Validates the selection cursor and updates the current index before dispatching the selected player entry with the generic PrevPlayer/NextPlayer pair.
Validates the cursor against entry count, resolves the indexed card record and dispatches using the generic PrevPlayer/NextPlayer pair.
